items.source: /// Expired/revoked and unbound legacy tokens make no usable catalog claim.

items.name: usable
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub const fn usable(record: &TokenRecord, now: i64) -> bool {
    !record.revoked
        && record.expires_at > now
        && record.client_kind.is_some()
        && record.principal_id.is_some()
}
